additional_info.subject: ID0415249-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R8 170002537] Fuse FC14 is constantly tripping CRM:00642002181
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing great.
We have received this case from an end customer. Based on the reported issue, we need to perform the following checks on the site.
FC14 tripping is an indicator for a short circuit (phase or ground)
FC14 is unfortunately a fuse for a lot of devices à complete door, cooling pump (depending on configuration, etc.), so if it is tripping the routers are off
Track it down to XD21 and more specifically to the display itself
At the displaycontroller there is a 3-pin connector for the 24 V
The same 24V are also routed through the board to a 10 pin connector for the RFID and credit card device
So there might be a short circuit somewhere in this chain à I would suggest to disconnect (all!) plugs of of RFID and CC in order to isolate the display
If FC14 is still stripping: the display controller or the connection from XD21 to the 3 pin controller is screwed up à metal sleeve falling of and short circuiting the board
Attached you can find more documents (Datasheet and wiring of the display, rework instruction for the display with a lot of detailed pictures
